## Message

```
error X18N1004: Invalid YAML plugin: <detail>
  Validate the file against `schema/plugin.json`.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A YAML plugin file does not match the plugin schema. The message names the file, the field and the problem.

1. Add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://x18n.antfu.dev/schema/plugin.json` as the first line of the file. Your editor then shows the errors.
2. Fix each field that the message lists. See [YAML plugins](/plugins/yaml).

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `2`.
